name: Economics Extended Minor
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

sections.title: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: For a course to fulfil a prerequisite, or for a required course to be accepted in an economics program students must have a grade of C- or higher.

sections.note: Students should fulfil Faculty requirements early in their programs and obtain broadly based backgrounds before entering upper division courses.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: In order to graduate from any ECON major, joint major, minor, or extended minor program, students must have a minimum ECON cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of 2.0 and a minimum ECON cumulative upper division grade point average (CUDGPA) of 2.0, calculated on all ECON courses completed at SFU.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete the same lower division requirements as a major.

sections.title: Lower Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete the following prior to program declaration with a minimum grade of C- (unless otherwise indicated).

requirements.title: One of MATH 150, MATH 151, MATH 154, MATH 157
One additional 200 division ECON course (other than ECON 201, 220W, and 233)

sections.note: Students who earn a grade of A- or better at Simon Fraser University on their first attempt in ECON 201 are exempt from the requirement of one additional 200 division ECON course.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete at least 15 upper division ECON units following the completion of 60 lower division units.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A maximum of eight ECON upper division units from another institution can be applied to the extended minor.

caveats: Converted automatically from the calendar; confirm with an advisor.
